source: User-supplied resources/lyrics-spelling/情路無尾巷-蕭煌奇

blocks.text: 敢會凍 麥來問 我的過去
blocks.spelling: kám ē-tàng mài lâi mn̄g guá ê kuè-khì

blocks.text: 過去的 無聊的夢 無記憶
blocks.spelling: kuè-khì ê bô-liâu ê bāng bô kì-ik

blocks.text: 喝一杯 無糖咖啡 我敬你
blocks.spelling: lím tsi̍t pue bô thn̂g ka-pi guá kìng lí

blocks.text: 愛情 隨人 滋味
blocks.spelling: ài-tsîng suî-lâng tsu-bī

blocks.text: 尚驚是 三更半眠 睡抹去
blocks.spelling: siōng kiann sī sann-kinn puànn bîn khùn buē khì

blocks.text: 綿綿的舊情 猷原浮置眼前
blocks.spelling: mî mî ê kū-tsîng iu-guân phû tì gán-tsîng

blocks.text: 你惦我的身邊 窗外雨水聲音 是空
blocks.spelling: lí tiām guá ê sin-pinn thang-guā hōo-tsuí ê siann-im sī khang

blocks.text: 愛過的人 斟酌聽
blocks.spelling: ài-kuè ê lâng tsim-tsiok thiann

blocks.text: 孤單是多情人心內的疼
blocks.spelling: koo-tuann sī to-tsîng lâng sim-lāi ê thiànn

blocks.text: 原諒我也 不敢望
blocks.spelling: guân-liōng guá iā m̄ kánn bāng

blocks.text: 明明 你愛我 將你當作是 過路的人
blocks.spelling: bîng-bîng lí ài guá tsiòng lí tòng-tsuè sī kuè-lōo ê lâng

blocks.text: 你愛的人 伊不是 無情人
blocks.spelling: lí ài ê lâng i m̄ sī bô-tsîng lâng

blocks.text: 伊只是 不敢走過 情路無尾巷
blocks.spelling: i tsí-sī m̄ kánn kiânn-kuè tsîng-lōo bô-bué-hāng

blocks.text: 感情呼伊一人 愛甲無酒也茫茫
blocks.spelling: kám-tsîng hoo i tsi̍t lâng ài kā bô tsiú iā bâng-bâng

blocks.text: 頭前是黑暗 越頭也無望
blocks.spelling: thâu-tsîng sī oo-àm ua̍t-thâu iā bô-bāng

blocks.text: 你愛的人 看破做 無情人
blocks.spelling: lí ài ê lâng khuànn phuà tsuè bô-tsîng lâng

blocks.text: 不願擱 再來走過 情路無尾巷
blocks.spelling: m̄-guān koh tsài lâi kiânn-kuè tsîng lōo bô-bué-hāng

blocks.text: 感情麥看許重 有緣感謝 你陪伴
blocks.spelling: kám-tsîng mài khuànn hia tāng ū-iân kám-siā lí puê-phuānn

blocks.text: 幸福有來過 只是抹凍到永遠
blocks.spelling: hīng-hok ū lâi-kuè tsí-sī buē-tàng kàu íng-uán
